item.title: Hams Help Forecasters with Real-Time Data on Northeast Blizzard
item.description: A historic blizzard paralyzed much of the Northeast in late February, and amateur radio operators were on the air to help forecasters keep track of the storm’s impact. Southeastern New England was one of the hardest-hit areas. item.description: Solar activity continued at low levels with isolated C-classflaring. Regions 4381 and 4384 remained the primary drivers ofactivity. item.title: Section Manager Nomination Results
item.description: The nomination period for the 2026 spring season Section Manager election cycle concluded on Friday, March 6. item.title: Indiana Hams Living Under HOAs Gain Antenna Protections
item.description: The Indiana General Assembly has passed and Governor Mike Braun has signed a bill that adds protection for amateur radio operators who live in homeowner association (HOA) regulated housing developments.
